## Approved plan task A0

- **Functional scope/files:** map the BO behaviors in `web_bridge.ex`, ChatLive and `channels/api.ex` to existing tests and the contract migrations in section 10. Identify uncovered behavior at Engine admission/finalization and delivery boundaries.
- **Tests before implementation:** run the affected suites; add focused characterization tests only for uncovered critical behavior: explicit BO bypass, request filtering, streaming replacement, final/error fallback, init/history and persistence failure. Tests preserve current behavior.
- **Branches:** empty input, fresh/resumed/missing conversation, empty history/welcome message, configured agent/default agent, filters, nil team IDs, status vs stream, stale events, error Outgoing/dispatch error/unexpected result, persistence failure.
- **Mocking:** preserve existing fixtures; identify legacy internal stubs that need mechanical migration, and separately disclose any changes to scenario semantics. External LLM remains deterministic.
- **Documentation:** BO regression matrix and test results in Beadwork.
- **Action reuse:** not applicable; regression coverage only.
- **Done:** existing failures classified, critical BO behaviors covered, and section 10 migrations tied to equivalent observable behavior.

## Execution requirements
Branch: refactor/webbridge. Source: GitHub www-zaq-ai/zaq#830. Read AGENTS.md, docs/exec-plans/PLAN_STRATEGY.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, and applicable service guides before implementation. Shared contracts, module responsibilities, reuse evidence, decisions and regression obligations are in parent zaq-pkd. Write specified immediate tests first; use real internal boundaries and mock only external edges. Preserve canonical-history authorization, config-scoped delivery and Engine admission/finalization. New/substantially rewritten feature E2E must wait for B3 human approval. Inbound message.edit is excluded; outbound streaming edits remain included.


## Sequencing
Root task; no implementation prerequisites.
Blocks zaq-pkd.2 (A1).
Human BO approval: zaq-pkd.7. Persistent consolidated E2E/regression issue: zaq-pkd.8. Widget decision gate: zaq-pkd.9.

comments.text: Baseline complete. Action reuse: not applicable — regression characterization only; no executable operation added or changed. Existing suites passed: WebBridge 5/5 before additions, ChatLive 93/93, Channels API 98/98, Engine admission/API 149/149 (345 total baseline assertions/tests across runs). Existing coverage already protects BO bypass, selected/default agent routing, filters, streaming replacement/finalization, stale responses, error fallbacks, conversation create/resume/missing fallback, empty/history restoration, persistence failures, connector-scoped delivery, admission deduplication and finalization. Added focused WebBridge characterizations for user_content metadata, atom status stage, streaming update intent, existing message update correlation, and malformed status no-op/no broadcast. Final focused suite 8/8; mix q passed; git diff --check passed. Observed non-failing environment warnings: unavailable :license_manager config and a transient MCP Finch GenServer error during ChatLive, while all tests passed.
